svg.title: Direct versus recursive XGBoost 14-day backtest
svg.desc: Ten non-overlapping 14-day backtests compare actual fictional repair-part requests with direct and recursive XGBoost predictions. A second panel shows mean absolute error by horizon, and a third shows overall MAE of 10.39 for seasonal naive, 8.71 for recursive XGBoost, and 8.52 for direct XGBoost.

cc:Work.dc:title: Direct versus recursive XGBoost 14-day backtest
cc:Work.dc:description: Generated comparison of actual daily repair-part requests, direct and recursive XGBoost forecasts, horizon errors, and overall mean absolute error.
